proof: Because L=n*d=350 and d is the minimum incidence degree, all seven live variables have degree exactly 50.
The inherited global-universe bound is integer-valued and at most 3365. Therefore any actual cap violation (>3364) must attain raw_units=3365 exactly.
Equality raw_units=3365 forces K=637 distinct raw clauses and total width Wmax_6(637)=2727. Hence the raw set contains all 64 width-6 signed clauses over the six nonpivot variables.
Since there are only c=28 retained clauses, at least 64-28=36 of those width-6 clauses must be new resolvents.

Because 36>2^5=32, for every one of the six nonpivot coordinates both literal signs must occur among these full-width resolvents: fixing one sign on any coordinate permits at most 32 full-width sign patterns.
K=c+p*q=28+609=637 also forces every one of the 609 cross-parent pairs to yield a new distinct non-tautological resolvent. Thus all p-by-q parent-tail pairs are sign-compatible.

For a fixed coordinate y, if both signs occur among tails in the p=21 bucket, sign-compatibility forces every one of the q=29 tails to omit y. But regular incidence gives omission_y=t_y<=c=28, contradiction because 29>28.

Therefore for every coordinate whose two signs occur in resolvents, the two-sign variation must lie in the q=29 bucket. Sign-compatibility then forces every one of the p=21 tails to omit that coordinate.

This conclusion holds for all six coordinates, so every tail in the p=21 bucket is empty. Each corresponding parent clause is then the pivot literal alone, contradicting the normalized unit-free stage.
Hence equality raw_units=3365 is impossible. Since the inherited integer upper bound is 3365, actual raw_units<=3364.
